newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - April 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - April 14.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Some 22 Saudi businessmen who imported consumer goods from a Hong Kong-based company have claimed losses of $15 million after discovering the imported items were damaged.
- The National Industrial Gases Company signs a contract with Germany's Linde AG and Riyadh-based Linarco Ltd to construct a grassroots air separation plant in Yanbu.
- Governor of Mecca opens a 566 million riyal power plant.
- Saudi investments in Egypt were worth 11.5 billion pounds until last November.
